title: ui-audit report
description: Machine-readable JSON report emitted by `scripts/check-ui-productization-audit.mjs --report <path>`. Schema version 1. Not the default human-readable text output.

schemaVersion.description: Gate report schema version. Locked to 1 for GATES-2.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the report was produced.

exitCode.description: Exit code produced by the run. 0=PASS, 1=FAIL, 2=classification conflict. The ui-audit script reserves 2 for future white-list conflicts; current invocations emit 0 or 1.

reportPath.description: Absolute filesystem path the report was written to. Omitted when write failed.

knownUiIds.description: Count of UI-### issue ids discovered in the commit log.

baselineAvailable.description: Whether the ENFORCEMENT_BASELINE commit is reachable from HEAD.

baselineShort.description: Short SHA prefix of the baseline commit (first 7 chars).

failures.description: Failure messages produced by the run. Empty array when none.

code.description: Stable failure code. UI_AUDIT_SYNC = commit modified UI surface without syncing audit ledger. UI_ID_MISSING = commit message lacks UI-### issue id. WORKTREE_UI = working tree contains UI changes without synced audit ledger.

commit.description: Short commit SHA (first 7 chars) when the failure is tied to a commit.

knownUiIds.description: Distinct UI-### issue ids discovered in the commit log, sorted ascending.
